messages:
anna.finance: Quick sync — procurement narrowed to LedgerFlow and BillSift for usage/invoice reconciliation. Main asks: accurate token-level usage mapping to our invoice, CSV/BigQuery export, and monthly/annual pricing options.

Derek.sourcing: Good. Do we have sample exports from both? we should check column names + timezone handling.

Anna.finance: I asked both vendors for a sample export of 30 days of usage and a live dashboard demo. LedgerFlow sent sample yesterday. BillSift asked for our sample logs first.

Jordan.eng: can you paste LedgerFlow sample headers? I want to validate that we can join on request_id + model.

Anna.finance: LedgerFlow CSV header: ```timestamp,request_id,customer_id,model_name,token_prompt,token_completion,total_tokens,cost_usd,region``` They include iso8601 tz.

Jordan.eng: nice. That will join cleanly. Also checking they provide API to pull raw events (webhook/paginated). If they only give aggregated metrics it's a no-go.

Sophia.billing: pricing note — LedgerFlow quoted $0.02/1000 tokens for ingestion + $800/mo platform fee. BillSift is proposing a tiered commit: $6k/mo for up to $250M tokens, then $0.015/1k after commit. Need modeling vs our forecast.

Derek.sourcing: Budget question — will we treat this as a subscription (SaaS) PO under RedW-FIN-OPS or as a contractor service? Procurement needs sku and GL code.

Anna.finance: Treat as SaaS. GL code = FIN-SW-SaaS. I'll need vendor W9 and SOC2 report before PO.

Derek.sourcing: On negotiation: can we get LedgerFlow to waive the platform fee for a 12-mo commit? That could make their price competitive. Also ask for 60-day trial of production data sync.

Anna.finance: I'll ask. For BillSift, ask for a 90-day pilot with a capped ingest (so we don't blow budget). Also request volume-based discount tiers in writing.

Jordan.eng: integration checklist for engineering:
- API keys + scoped service accounts
- webhook replay support
- BQ / S3 export
- schema stability SLA
- PII redaction guarantees (we'll only send hashed ids)

If any vendor can't confirm these, flag them.

Sophia.billing: Quick approval path: finance approves spend up to $10k/mo via manager signoff. Anything above needs FP&A + head of finance. We should budget the pilot under engineering research credits if possible.

Derek.sourcing: @procurement-bot can you create an approval ticket and attach LedgerFlow sample CSV + BillSift ask?

procurement-bot: Ticket created: PR-2026-0452 — Vendor eval request. Assigned to @derek.sourcing. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PR-2026-0452 :white_check_mark:

Anna.finance: Added the legal checklist to the ticket (SOC2, DPA, IP indemnity, termination on breach). We also need data residency confirmation (EU data remains in EU region) for some customers.

Jordan.eng: one more technical ask — can vendors normalize cost per inference for multi-model responses? e.g., if request uses two models (reranker + gen) we need line items. LedgerFlow said yes, BillSift uncertain. Marking BillSift as follow-up.

Sophia.billing: For negotiation leverage — suggest a 12mo commit with monthly true-ups. Ask for invoice granularity (daily line items) and CSV export by cost center tag. That's non-negotiable for accounting.

Derek.sourcing: I can push for a 10% discount on commits and removal/waiver of onboarding fee. I'll also ask for a SOW that ties deliverables to the waived fee.

Anna.finance: Action items:
- Anna: request waived fee + 12mo commit pricing from LedgerFlow (due EOD Fri)
- Derek: negotiate pilot terms and SOW with BillSift (due Mon)
- Jordan: validate webhook + export schema from both (due Tue)
- Sophia: model cost scenarios for both pricing options and earliest approval threshold (due Wed)

Please update PR-2026-0452 when done. :thumbsup:

Derek.sourcing: noted.

Jordan.eng: will need test dataset (anonymized) — Anna can you generate?

Anna.finance: Yep, attaching anonymized sample to the ticket now.

Sophia.billing: FYI — if LedgerFlow wants an enterprise contract, Legal will need 2 weeks for review. Keep timeline in mind.

Anna.finance: thanks all. Will ping again once vendors reply with updated pricing.

Derek.sourcing: thanks — small followup: anyone on finance ok with a pre-approved cap of $15k for the pilot to avoid delays? we can revert after POC.

Sophia.billing: I can approve up to $15k for pilot under manager signoff. Anything above we escalate.

Anna.finance: great, locking that in. End of thread.
